title: Tutor or extracurricular program vetting
description: Vet a tutor, camp, or extracurricular program by checking credentials and background information and reading review sentiment, then score fit before a parent decides.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: tutor-program-vetting
  title: Tutor or extracurricular program vetting
  description: Vet a tutor, camp, or extracurricular program by checking credentials and background information and reading review sentiment, then score fit before a parent decides.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a scored, parent-approved vetting summary for a candidate tutor, camp, or extracurricular program.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: [parent-approval]
  nodes:
    - id: program-candidate-info
      kind: input
      name: Program candidate and child profile
      summary: The tutor, camp, or extracurricular program being considered and the child's needs.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The tutor, camp, or extracurricular program being considered and the child's needs." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: credential-background-checker
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Credential and background checker
      summary: Checks stated credentials and publicly available background information.
      role: Credential and background-check researcher
      prompt: Research the tutor or program's stated credentials, certifications, and any publicly available background-check or licensing information. Describe which official registries, licensing boards, or background-check services to consult rather than asserting unverified claims. This is not legal advice, and the family should independently verify credentials and run any required background checks themselves before enrolling the child.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: review-sentiment-reader
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Review sentiment reader
      summary: Summarizes parent and student review sentiment.
      role: Parent review sentiment analyst
      prompt: Read available parent and student reviews of the program and summarize the overall sentiment, common praise, and recurring concerns. Note the approximate volume of reviews so a single outlier review is not overweighted, and describe where the family can read the original reviews themselves.
      capabilities: { skills: [decision-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: parallel-vetting-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel credential and review check
      summary: Runs the credential check and review-sentiment read side by side.
      config: { members: [credential-background-checker, review-sentiment-reader], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: vote-on-findings
      kind: aggregator
      name: Vote on combined findings
      summary: Combines findings so no single outlier review or claim dominates.
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: score-program-safety-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score program safety and fit
      summary: Scores the combined findings for safety, credibility, and fit.
      role: Independent program safety and fit evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the combined credential and review findings and return a score, pass/fail, and clear reasons covering safety, credibility, and fit for the child. This is advisory research support only, not a professional safety certification, and the family should confirm any credential or background claim independently before enrolling.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.75 }
    - id: parent-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Parent sign-off on program
      summary: Pause for the parent to review the vetting summary and decide.
    - id: vetting-output
      kind: output
      name: Program vetting summary and decision
      summary: The final vetting summary and the parent's decision.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: program-candidate-info, to: parallel-vetting-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: parallel-vetting-group, to: vote-on-findings, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: vote-on-findings, to: score-program-safety-fit, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: score-program-safety-fit, to: parent-approval, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: parent-approval, to: vetting-output, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
